preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 50,000.
The number of nodes N and the integer K are within the specified bounds.
The values assigned to each node are non-negative and do not exceed 10^9.
The nodes are numbered from 1 to N and the edges are between distinct nodes.

preconditions.expression: Sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5
preconditions.description: The total number of nodes across all test cases does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.expression: Output is a single integer for each test case
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is the maximum possible value of the bitwise AND of the XOR sums of the nodes in each of the K trees.
